about: Order-dependent tests the shuffle census (scripts/ci-shuffle-census.mjs, #4405) found and nobody has fixed at the cause yet. One entry per failing test and seed; `seam` names the group the fix belongs to (first-error evidence, not a root-cause analysis). The list only shrinks: delete an entry in the PR that fixes it, and lower PINNED_MEMBERS in tests/scripts/ci-shuffle-census.test.ts. Reproduce with `npx vitest run <file> --sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=<seed>`.
